reason: Moved TaskStatusTag and TaskPriorityTag into web/app/(routes)/(app)/projects/[projectId]/components/ and imported them from there; web/app/components/ keeps pieces used by two or more screens.

Left open: the design-system Input accepts only type text, email, tel or url (InputProps), so type="time" fails tsc and loses the native time picker; the FormControl recipe's DoorsTime pattern is the documented way to build time fields.
Known emails moved from a module-level Set into the persistent auth store state, updated on sign-up and on email change, so the email-taken check survives reload.
EditNoteDialog now shows the gone message only when the note load finished without data, and shows the form while it is still loading.
EditTaskDialog now shows the gone message only when the task load finished without data, and shows the form while it is still loading.
EditSessionTypeDialog now shows the gone message only when the session type load finished without data, and shows the form while it is still loading.
The S15 title falls back to Your booking until slot.data.startAt is present, so formatSlotTitle is never called with an empty date.
The S08 status and priority filters now carry visible Status and Priority labels beside the search.
